description: r0b0tlab's four-GB10 SGLang serve of the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash checkpoint: TP=4 with EP=4, vision retained, a local file-backed Engram lookup, static DSpark K=5 and the overlay-v4 adapter on SGLang da64c5cb. Upstream's production profile is the exclusive C1 512K retrieval envelope (one running request, chunked prefill 256, 0.80 memory fraction, advertised 524,288 tokens); its 8-request candidate profile and K=3 variant are options, the 1M profile is deferred upstream. Upstream reports Q200v2 189/200, 512K needle retrieval passed and about 31 tok/s short single-stream; these are upstream claims, not measured here. Package code MIT; the model is MIT (information only).
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash SGLang TP4 four Sparks (r0b0tlab)
